title: LLM_SECURITY_REDTEAM_WRITEUP
what_it_does: Offensive AI security handbook, interactive CTF writeup portal, and 4-layer defense architecture reference.
how_it_works: Documents exploit primitives, multi-turn crescendo attacks, RAG poisoning, and tool abuse across 24 Wraith Academy targets with spoiler controls and deep technical modals.
what_it_solved: Demystifies LLM vulnerabilities beyond statistical base-model alignment with documented exploit primitives and a 4-layer defense-in-depth framework.
business_impact: Official WCAP Holder #50 certified methodology (1392/1600) with 100% lab exploitation coverage (24/24 targets) and production-ready guardrail designs.

case_study.problem: Base-model alignment is a statistical floor, not an authorization boundary. Integrating LLMs with external tools, APIs, and RAG pipelines introduces prompt injection, multi-turn crescendo attacks, delimiter collisions, and SSRF exfiltration.
case_study.built: Achieved WCAP Holder #50 (1392/1600) with 100% flag capture (24/24 targets) across Wraith Academy. Built an open-source offensive AI security field guide and interactive zero-dependency web portal featuring spoiler-protected payloads and deep modal dossiers.
case_study.architecture: Input Classifier (L1) → LLM Core → Output Classifier (L2) → Secret Gating (L3) → Sandboxed Tools (L4)

title: NUCLEI_CNM
what_it_does: Distributed multi-node manager & dashboard for Nuclei engine.
how_it_works: Orchestrates parallel scan nodes, syncs YAML templates, and aggregates alerts via Vue.js & Docker.
what_it_solved: Replaces manual CLI scan execution across multiple servers with automated template and result synchronization.
business_impact: Enables central template management and worker health coordination across multiple nodes.

case_study.problem: Managing Nuclei scans across multiple workers can become difficult when scan jobs, templates, results, and worker health need to be coordinated from a central interface.
case_study.built: A distributed management dashboard automating worker node coordination, real-time log aggregation, template syncing, and container health monitoring.

title: API_PENTEST
what_it_does: Automated API security testing fuzzer for RESTful endpoints.
how_it_works: Probes parameter matrices for authorization defects, rate-limiting, and input-validation vulnerabilities.
what_it_solved: Exposes common logic flaws and missing authorization controls in RESTful web services.
business_impact: Automates REST parameter fuzzing to identify potential IDOR and BOLA vulnerabilities before release.

title: SecurityHeaderScanner

how_it_works: Audits CSP policies, HSTS, CORS wildcard configurations, and cookie flags.
what_it_solved: Identifies missing or insecure HTTP headers prior to production deployments.
business_impact: Generates structured JSON header compliance reports aligned with OWASP security standards.

title: Js-And-Endpoints-scanner
what_it_does: JavaScript bundle inspection and endpoint extraction utility.
how_it_works: Parses client-side bundles to identify API keys, endpoints, and routing schemes.
what_it_solved: Exposes hidden API endpoints and credentials compiled in production bundles.
business_impact: Extracts endpoints and potential API tokens from client-side JS bundles for vulnerability scoping.

title: CAPTIVE_AUDIT

what_it_solved: Exposes perimeter leaks and verification gaps in public wireless networks.
business_impact: Audits captive portal DNS delegation and MAC address validation patterns in authorized environments.
